Messages.Author: Mike Mayer
Messages.Body:
I have a question that came up in my playing group...

If you try to steal blood from a vampire as a strike(Theft of Vitae)
can the other vampire prevent it (Skin of Rock, Flak Jacket, etc)?

The reason I was wondering is that I thought you can't steal blood
off a vampire and send it to torpor (as torpor is a result of taking more
damage than than the vampire can heal...)

I may be wrong (probably am) but can someone correct/confirm me?

Mike

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <95129.14...@psuvm.psu.edu>,

Mike Mayer <MR...@psuvm.psu.edu> wrote:
>I have a question that came up in my playing group...
>
> If you try to steal blood from a vampire as a strike(Theft of Vitae)
>can the other vampire prevent it (Skin of Rock, Flak Jacket, etc)?

Stolen Blood is not Damage - you do not heal it and cannot prevent it.
You may still dodge the strike, however.

> The reason I was wondering is that I thought you can't steal blood
>off a vampire and send it to torpor (as torpor is a result of taking more
>damage than than the vampire can heal...)

Right, steal doesn't inflict damage.
